rules.title: Hotel nightly cap
rules.rule: Hotel room rate per night must not exceed the city cap (Seattle $250, San Francisco $300, Boston $275, Chicago $230, Austin $210, Dallas $200, all other cities $200), excluding taxes.

rules.title: Personal hotel charges
rules.rule: Minibar, in-room movies, spa and other personal charges are not reimbursable.

rules.title: Travel meals
rules.rule: Meals while travelling are reimbursed up to $75 per person per day.

rules.title: Client entertainment
rules.rule: Client meals and entertainment are reimbursed up to $120 per person. List the attendees and the client in the business purpose.

rules.title: Alcohol
rules.rule: Alcohol is reimbursable only as part of client entertainment.

rules.title: Receipts
rules.rule: An itemized receipt is required for every expense of $25 or more.

rules.title: Class of travel
rules.rule: Book economy for flights under 6 hours. Book at least 14 days ahead where possible.

rules.title: Ground transport
rules.rule: Taxis and rideshare are reimbursable. Car rentals longer than 3 days need manager pre-approval.

rules.title: Business purpose
rules.rule: Every report needs a business purpose, and the client name if the trip was client-related.

rules.title: Submission deadline
rules.rule: Submit expenses within 30 days of the trip ending.

rules.title: Policy exceptions
rules.rule: Any expense above a policy limit needs a written justification on the report and is approved by your manager.

rules.title: Duplicate charges
rules.rule: Each charge may be claimed once. Report duplicate card charges to Finance Operations so the card provider can reverse them.
